id: title:Gilbert09:stream bing ads reports instead of holding them in memory

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces peak memory consumption and improves reliability of warehouse ingestion workflows by replacing batch CSV parsing with streaming generators, preventing OOM failures on large account reports.
review.reason: The observed hunks demonstrate a substantive, bounded improvement: replacing batch-returning CSV parsing and report fetching with streaming generators. P1.F4.H3 explicitly removes batch-returning functions and their callers, while P1.F4.H5 adds streaming page iteration and a page_rows parameter. This change directly addresses warehouse ingestion reliability and tiered account reach
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation of the streaming behavior is not shown, and no tests, migration, or configuration changes are provided. No adoption or incident avoidance evidence is available. The tier is assigned based on the removal of batch-returning functions and addition of streaming replacements, but the complete implementation and its validation are not visible.
